$comment: Claims the kit makes about connector parameters, each tied to the schema text that backs it. tools/check_drift.py (check 4) fails when a claim disappears from its file (claim_regex) or when the snapshot text at schema_path no longer contains every must_contain string. Optional fields: param and enum give the machine-readable allowed values (used for eval expect guards); note says what the fact protects. file may be a list, in which case the claim must appear in at least one of them.

facts.note: Trade history echoes span; only these presets exist (no custom dates). Eval guard: span is required and one of the enum.
Trade history pages by next_cursor until it comes back empty.
Rows mix equities, options, crypto and prediction markets with no asset-class field, so a row is never assumed to be a share sale.
The two account-number fields matched on the capture accounts, so the per-tool key/value rule comes from the schemas.
Official closes only come back for 20 or fewer symbols.
Option quote batches of 20 or fewer keep the prior-session close.
mark_alerts_read takes fired-event ids from get_alert_log, at most 100 per call.

must_contain: repeat the same asset_class, since, and limit
facts.note: Alert-log pages by next_cursor with the same filters on every page.
Crypto alerts use the base asset code, not the pair.
Order source filter used by the report card and the wash sweep (agentic, user, recurring, DRIP).
Specified-lot sells pass open_lot_id and quantity (at most quantity_available), 30 lots at most.
Option chains carry extended_hours_state, which gates the CURB sessions.
AM/PM settlement is read from each chain's settle_on_open.
Politician trades are attributed to Tip Ranks, shown as ranges, and lag by up to 45 days.
The SEC filing index pages by its next field.
Option instruments page by the cursor inside the next URL.

must_contain: Exactly one account is tradable by you
facts.note: Exactly one account has agentic_allowed=true; it is the only tradable account.
The schema promises an index state, but the live capture returned it empty; it is never used as a session signal.

must_contain: Does NOT return reliable buying power
facts.note: Buying power comes from get_portfolio, never get_accounts.
Review alerts (order_checks) are shown verbatim.
place_advanced_order places a live OCO; it belongs on the never-call list (audit C7).
Trade history takes key account_number with the rhs_account_number value (audit C1).
Realized P&L takes key account_number with the rhs_account_number value (audit M1).
Cancelling an OCO cancels both legs.

must_contain: Cancel all queued exercise requests for an option position
facts.note: cancel_option_exercise cancels every queued exercise for the option, not one.

must_contain: a call without confirm deletes nothing and returns a preview
facts.note: delete_alert previews first and deletes only with confirm=true; there is no undo.

must_contain: Simulate a stock order without placing it
facts.note: review_equity_order simulates; it places nothing.

must_contain: Simulate a crypto order without placing it
facts.note: preview_crypto_order simulates; it places nothing.
review_option_order names replace_option_order, which the connector does not expose.

must_contain: Never substitute a default such as 1 share or $100
facts.note: Size always comes from the user.

must_contain: prefer a marketable limit at the current ask over a plain market
facts.note: Immediate fills use a marketable limit rather than a market order.
Reviews run only against the Agentic account; there is no broker simulation for other accounts.
cancel_advanced_order takes the advanced-order id, not a leg's id.
An exercise can be cancelled only while queued.

must_contain: irrevocable once state moves past queued
facts.note: An exercise is irrevocable once it moves past queued.

must_contain: Set true only after the user approved the preview
facts.note: confirm: true is sent only on the second call, after the user approves the preview.
Pausing an alert is update_alert with enabled false, not a delete.
mark_alerts_read takes at most 100 ids per call.
all_through clears every symbol up to that instant and never takes a future time.
Scan filter updates replace the whole set.

must_contain: Cortex-managed scans are read-only via MCP
facts.note: Cortex-managed scans cannot be modified through MCP.

must_contain: When the user has already specified the name, call this directly
facts.note: create_watchlist runs without an extra confirmation when the user named the list.

must_contain: True to return only currently-open positions
facts.note: Current option holdings need nonzero: true (audit C3). Eval guard: nonzero is true.

must_contain: pass the cursor query param from the prior response's next URL
facts.note: Positions, lots, orders, instruments and currency pairs page by the cursor inside the next URL.

must_contain: pass the value from the prior response's next field
facts.note: The SEC filing index pages by its next field.
The SEC facts catalog pages by next_offset.
Trade history, news, alerts and the alert log page by next_cursor.

must_contain: repeat the same asset_class, since, and limit
facts.note: An alert-log cursor is reused with the same filters.

must_contain: new, queued, confirmed, unconfirmed, partially_filled, filled, cancelled, rejected, failed, voided
facts.note: Equity order state filter takes a single value from this list.

must_contain: queued, confirmed, partially_filled, filled, rejected, cancelled, failed, voided, pending_cancelled
facts.note: Option order state filter takes a single value from this list.
Crypto spells canceled with one l and offers state_group open or closed.

must_contain: naive values are interpreted as UTC
facts.note: created_at_gte without an offset is read as UTC.

must_contain: call get_equity_orders, get_option_orders, get_crypto_orders, and get_advanced_orders in parallel
facts.note: A broad orders request reads all four order families so OCO groups are not missed.

must_contain: day, week, month, 3month, year, or all
facts.note: Realized P&L presets; the default is 3month (audit C4).

must_contain: Use with end_date instead of span
facts.note: Custom dates replace span; they never go together.
Trade-history presets; the default is week, unlike realized P&L (audit C4).
Trade history has presets only.

must_contain: one or more of equity, option, crypto
facts.note: Realized P&L filters cover equity, option and crypto only, while trade history also includes prediction markets.

must_contain: Above 20 symbols, quotes still return but closes is omitted with closes_error set
facts.note: Equity quote batches of 20 or fewer keep the official close.

must_contain: Above 20, quotes still return but closes is omitted with closes_error set
facts.note: Option quote batches of 20 or fewer keep the official close.
Crypto's previous close is a midnight boundary, US Eastern by default.

must_contain: Pass ONLY when the user's timezone is known from context
facts.note: Never guess the timezone parameter.
Crypto quote symbols come back as BTCUSD, not BTC-USD.
get_indexes takes a comma-separated string, not an array.

must_contain: placed after hours as regular_hours they queue for the next regular open
facts.note: After-hours market and stop orders tagged regular_hours queue for the next open.

must_contain: rejected if tagged to another session
facts.note: Market and stop orders tagged to a non-regular session are rejected.

must_contain: Fractional and dollar-based orders only place in regular_hours
facts.note: Fractional and dollar-amount orders run in regular hours only.
Equity sessions and what each means.
OCO orders run in regular hours only.

must_contain: CURB requires an index chain with extended_hours_state='enabled'
facts.note: Option sessions; CURB only on index chains with extended hours enabled.
A CURB rejection appears only when placing.
search resolves instruments, crypto pairs or indexes by asset_type.
Array parameters take a list even for one value.
exercise_option.quantity is an integer, unlike the other quantities.
ratio_quantity is an integer.
Prices and quantities are decimal strings.
A retry after a transport error reuses the same ref_id.

must_contain: windows wider than 31 days are rejected
facts.note: The earnings calendar spans at most 31 days either way.
high_market_cap hides names under $1B.

must_contain: Returns the trailing up to 8 quarters
facts.note: get_earnings_results covers up to 8 trailing quarters.

must_contain: option_level_2 enables long calls/puts, covered calls, and cash-secured puts
facts.note: Level 2 strategies, available on any account type.

must_contain: option_level_3 additionally requires a margin or limited-margin account
facts.note: Level 3 needs a margin or limited-margin account.

must_contain: Multi-leg is not available on cash or retirement accounts through this tool
facts.note: No multi-leg option orders in cash or retirement accounts.

must_contain: If option_level is empty or option_level_0, do NOT call
facts.note: No options review without an options level.

must_contain: switch to a margin/limited-margin account via get_limited_margin_upgrade_info, then re-fetch get_accounts
facts.note: Cash account wanting L3: limited margin first, re-read accounts, then the options upgrade.

must_contain: Do NOT call when the account already has the required level or higher
facts.note: No upgrade link when the level already suffices.
The onboarding tool only returns the link.

must_contain: 'stop_loss' is a 'stop order' and 'stop_limit' a 'stop limit order'
facts.note: Crypto stop types are named by their app names when speaking to the user.
Crypto quantities are coins, never shares.
Crypto tax_lots (at most 50) need get_crypto_tax_lots, which is absent, so specific-lot crypto sells happen in the app.
Price book: at most 4 symbols per call.
Tradability: at most 10 symbols per call.
Equity historicals: at most 10 symbols per call.
Fundamentals: at most 10 symbols per call.
Financials: at most 20 symbols per call.
Analyst ratings: at most 75 symbols per call.
Alert log: at most 100 events per page.
Currency pairs: at most 700 per page.

must_contain: at least 0.25% away from the current market price
facts.note: Each OCO leg sits at least 0.25% from the market.

must_contain: at least $0.10 apart from each other
facts.note: OCO legs are at least $0.10 apart.
A sell OCO has take-profit above stop.
OCO quantities are whole shares.
At most 30 lots per specified-lot sell.
dollar_amount only with market orders.

must_contain: 'gtc' (good for 90 days), 'gfd' (good for day), 'gfw' (good for 7 days), or 'gfm' (good for 30 days)
facts.note: Crypto stop orders take gtc, gfd, gfw or gfm.

must_contain: market and limit: 'gtc' (good till canceled) only
facts.note: Crypto market and limit orders are gtc only.

must_contain: 'ioc' is NEVER supported for crypto orders
facts.note: No ioc for crypto.

must_contain: defaults to gtc for market and limit, and gfd for stop_loss and stop_limit
facts.note: A crypto stop without a time in force lasts one day.
A dollar-sized crypto market sell can come back up to about 5% light.
Option orders carry 1 to 4 legs.

must_contain: Only 'limit' is available with 2 or more legs
facts.note: Multi-leg option orders are limit only.
Multi-leg orders state debit or credit.
Leg ratios are in lowest terms.

must_contain: stop_market is sell-to-close only with stop_price below the current ask
facts.note: Option stop_market is sell-to-close only.

must_contain: CURB requires an index chain with extended_hours_state='enabled'
facts.note: CURB needs an index chain with extended hours enabled.
Alert bar sizes in seconds.
VWAP alerts use 5-minute bars only.
Price crossing the SMA line is price_crosses_sma, not sma_crosses.

must_contain: resolved as an equity first, then as crypto
facts.note: Without asset_class a crypto ticker resolves as an equity first; always pass it. Eval guard: asset_class is equity or crypto.

must_contain: Index options cannot be manually exercised
facts.note: Index options cannot be exercised by hand.

must_contain: revenue, gross profit, net income, and net margin
facts.note: get_financials returns 4 metrics only (audit M21).
get_financials returns at most 40 periods per symbol.
